GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down =lead 3 Wide line of 4 Not Given Much Hope 1st up although 2nd did sit Four Wide Straightened Up handy No Match from 100 but a # sound return
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide and without cover throughout.  Rider reported he was instructed to ride his mount in a positive manner. Added, however, after beginning well and being mindful that the mare was resuming, he did not want to make too much use of the mare in the early stages and settle closer to the lead as the runners to his inside showed superior speed.  Added he was then unable to gain cover and settled in a three-wide position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward = Lead Outside 3 Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths faced breeze , lay out 3 Wide Turning for home Under Pressure and Couldn'T Go On - # Quickly Beaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. When questioned, rdr stated he was asked to ride the mare in a forward position but not necessarily to lead, but when caught wide in the early stages he rode his mnt forward to settle outside the lead. He said after receiving contact from another runner on the home turn, the mare gave ground abruptly and when he felt there was something amiss he eased it down in the straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr rep subsequently reported the mare pulled up well but it has come to the end of a long preparation and has now been spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Caught 3 Wide early Restrained Settled Down well back 3 Wide with a trail 6 Lengths , held together same to straightening up clear run home couldn't quicken couldn't finish off - # 3 Wide 1-paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported although obliged to race three wide, he was able to obtain cover from the 1000m, however the mare was very disappointing in its failure to close off and raced flat. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr rep subsequently reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the mare and advised at this stage the intention is to continue with its current preparation.
